meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE (DGCI&S data)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional, revised and final versions are published; we keep the most final version of each period and name it in meta.revision.
meta.coverage: India's merchandise exports, imports and trade balance each month since April 1990, with oil and non-oil since April 1997, US$ million
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 433 (totals) and 426 (oil and non-oil), DGCI&S data as republished by the RBI. In February and March 2017 the oil and non-oil exports sum about 1.3% above the total (the split is an earlier print); shown as published. The latest months are provisional (quick estimates); meta.revision names the version of each month. Oil exports are petroleum products; oil imports are crude oil and petroleum products.
